description: Activate when the user needs to verify citations, check source accuracy, or validate that referenced papers actually support the claims attributed to them. Retrieves source abstracts and full text (for open-access papers), compares each citation claim against actual source content, and produces a structured verification report with classifications (VERIFIED, PLAUSIBLE, MISMATCH, UNVERIFIABLE, NOT FOUND).
